Case Studies

Real situations.
Real outcomes.

All case studies are anonymized. These represent the types of challenges we navigate. See what becomes possible when the right expertise is in the room.

Tech & SaaS · Change Management

Scaling through 400% headcount growth without losing the culture

The Challenge

A Series B company needed to scale from 40 to 200 employees in 18 months while maintaining the culture and psychological safety that defined their early team.

Less than 5% attrition through the growth period. Performance management, compensation philosophy, and manager enablement launched from scratch.

Healthcare · L&D & Enablement

Reducing GTM lead time by 37% with a new readiness operating model

The Challenge

A global clinical organization's product launches were stalled by misalignment between Engineering, Product, and Revenue teams, costing months of go-to-market time.

GTM lead time reduced from 3 months to 8 weeks. Unified readiness model adopted across four regions.

Individual · Employee Relations

Navigating a performance improvement plan, and coming out stronger

The Challenge

A mid-level manager received a PIP they believed was retaliatory. They needed an expert to help understand their rights and respond strategically.

Client negotiated terms, documented performance, and transitioned to a senior role with a strong exit package.
